ids.instruction: Never mint or hand-write an ID. IDs are minted host-side where the entity is written; read the id back off the entity card `agent_qa_get_entity` returns.

secrets.advice: Only the values in workspace.secretsFile are masked, and nothing else is. The one exception: the dashboard's model connection check keeps the key or header value it is testing out of the provider's error message. Use temporary, limited test credentials.

keys.name: A lowercase slug, unique in the list. local is reserved for this machine.
keys.protocol: playwright for a Playwright server (ws:// or wss://), or cdp for a CDP endpoint (ws://, wss://, http:// or https://; Chromium only).
keys.url: The endpoint with its scheme, host and port written out. {{secret:<name>}} and {{playwright:version}} may appear only in its path and query, never as user:password@.
keys.query: Parameters added to the url when agent-qa connects. A value is a string, or a nested map sent as JSON.
keys.basicAuth: user and password; the password is a {{secret:<name>}} reference. Use it or an Authorization header, not both.
keys.connectTimeout: A duration such as 45s that bounds the connect only; 5m by default.
keys.context: cdp only: new (the default) opens agent-qa's own context; reuse uses the browser's first context.

remotes.credentials: Every credential is a {{secret:<name>}} reference to a name in workspace.secretsFile. The strict parse refuses a literal string under a header or query name that carries a credential word such as token, key, secret, password, cookie, authorization or jwt: in nested maps, inside a JSON value and in the url's own query. A boolean, number or null under such a name is an option and is accepted. A credential goes over ws:// or http:// only to this machine. A remote's secrets serve its connection only; steps, expected values, target urls and hooks cannot use them.

pick.value: A name listed under registry.remotes, or local for this machine.
pick.order: The suite's pick wins, then the test's, then the config's; with none, the test runs here. A suite runs in one place, so when it names none, its members must agree.

remotes.writes: agent_qa_change_config can set use.browser.remote but never changes registry.remotes or plugins; a person edits those in the file.
